LESSON: LISTEN TO

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listen to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Listen to. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through 

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: LISTEN TO
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Listen to helps you succeed in LITERACY ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: LISTEN TO
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through 

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through . You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through .
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Listen to”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through . Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Listen to is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Listen to”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through )

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Listen to to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through .
3. Make one local Kenya example of Listen to from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Listen to: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Listen to?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Listen to means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: demonstrate an understanding and small groups) of a set of instructions through .

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
